title: 22-Layer ZnS/MgF2 with Bounded Quasi-Periodic Initialization and Two-Phase Optimizer
scientific_hypothesis: Constraining thickness initialization to a bounded quasi-periodic schedule centered at ~1050 nm with [750, 1250] nm bounds, combined with a two-phase optimizer (pair-wise joint optimization followed by decoupled fine-tuning), will preserve local optical phase continuity and reduce destructive interference spikes compared to unconstrained initialization.
design_principle: Quarter-wave stack with alternating high/low index materials, initialized near modal thickness from prior successful iteration, optimized in two phases to maintain phase ramp continuity.
proposed_topology: exactly 6 alternating ZnS/MgF2 pairs (12 finite layers)
soft_objectives: Maximize mean transmittance in 3.25-3.35 um and 4.20-4.30 um passbands
Minimize mean transmittance in 2.50-3.10 um and 4.45-5.00 um stopbands
manufacturing_considerations: Thickness bounds [750, 1250] nm ensure depositable ranges
Two-phase optimization reduces sensitivity to deposition errors
theory_basis: Transfer matrix method for coherent thin-film interference
Quarter-wave stack principle for bandpass filtering
expected_advantages: Reduced destructive interference spikes compared to round 2
Better phase continuity across layer interfaces
known_risks: May not reach iteration_01's 0.955 score due to tighter bounds
Two-phase optimizer may converge to local minima
execution_request_english: Optimize a 22-layer alternating ZnS/MgF2 thin-film stack on CaF2 substrate under air incidence. Initialize all layer thicknesses to a quasi-periodic schedule centered at 1050 nm with bounds [750, 1250] nm. Implement two-phase optimization: Phase 1 jointly optimizes adjacent layer pairs (d_i, d_{i+1}) for i=1,3,5,...,21 to preserve local optical phase continuity; Phase 2 decouples all 22 layers for fine-grained thickness tuning. Target: maximize mean transmittance in passbands [3250-3350 nm, 4200-4300 nm] and minimize mean transmittance in stopbands [2500-3100 nm, 4450-5000 nm]. Use coherent TMM solver with normal unpolarized illumination. Output thicknesses_nm array, best_target_score, valid_candidates count, and tightest_margin. Topology realization override: disregard any symbolic repeat count, range, or ellipsis above and use exactly 6 alternating ZnS/MgF2 pairs (12 finite layers). Optimize only continuous physical thicknesses; the task compiler must fully expand every finite layer. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 2500-3100 nm, 3250-3350 nm, 4200-4300 nm, 4450-5000 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 3.25-3.35 um and 4.20-4.30 um bands; Low transmittance in 2.50-3.10 um and 4.45-5.00 um bands. behaviors to suppress or avoid: High transmittance in 2.50-3.10 um and 4.45-5.00 um bands. manufacturing constraints: Total layer count <= 24; No metal layers; Conventional depositable infrared inorganic dielectric materials only.
revision_reason: Implements feedback directive: replaces unconstrained thickness initialization with bounded quasi-periodic schedule centered on ~1050 nm, adds two-phase optimizer to mitigate destructive interference spikes observed in iteration_05.
